title: Structural Entropy-Driven Graph Diffusion Generation for One-Shot Federated Graph Learning
abstract: arXiv:2609.06499v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: One-shot federated graph learning (FGL) requires the server to estimate client contributions from highly compressed information, yet conventional volume-based weighting captures the amount of client data while overlooking how its connectivity is organized. In this paper, we propose SPIRE, a Structural Entropy-Driven Graph Diffusion Generation method that introduces topology-aware client differentiation into one-shot FGL. Specifically, we employ first-order degree-distribution structural entropy as a compact descriptor of degree-mass dispersion and use it to derive structural client weights, providing an inductive bias that accounts for differences in graph topology beyond data volume. On the generation side, a graph diffusion model on the server synthesizes pseudographs conditioned on the weighted client prototypes, capturing both semantic and structural information without requiring additional client-side training. translated_title: 结构熵驱动的图扩散生成方法用于一次性联邦图学习
translated_abstract: 一次性联邦图学习要求服务器从高度压缩的信息中估计客户端的贡献，然而传统的基于数据量的加权方式只捕捉了客户端数据的数量，却忽略了其连接性的组织方式。在本文中，我们提出了SPIRE，一种结构熵驱动的图扩散生成方法，将拓扑感知的客户端差异化引入一次性联邦图学习。具体而言，我们采用一阶度分布结构熵作为度质量离散度的紧凑描述符，并据此推导出结构性客户端权重，提供了一种能够考虑数据量之外图拓扑差异的归纳偏置。在生成方面，服务器上的图扩散模型以加权客户端原型为条件合成伪图，在无需额外客户端训练的情况下同时捕捉语义和结构信息。
tldr: 该论文提出SPIRE方法，利用一阶度分布结构熵推导拓扑感知的客户端权重，并在服务器端通过图扩散模型以加权客户端原型为条件合成伪图，从而在一次性联邦图学习中超越传统仅基于数据量的加权方式，无需额外客户端训练即可融合语义与结构信息。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes SPIRE, which derives topology-aware structural client weights from first-order degree-distribution structural entropy and uses a server-side graph diffusion model to synthesize pseudographs conditioned on weighted client prototypes, moving beyond volume-based weighting in one-shot federated graph learning without additional client-side training.
